title: Hausarztpraxis Ries
description: hausarzt-praxis-ries.de Hausarztpraxis Ries is a family general practice in Frickenhausen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany, run by three doctors from the Ries family offering comprehensive primary care for patients aged 14 and above. Its services span acute and chronic disease treatment, minor surgery, pain therapy, palliative care, geriatric medicine and acupuncture. The practice is equipped with ECG, Holter monitoring, ultrasound, spirometry and an in-house lab plus disease management programs for diabetes, coronary disease and asthma. Led by Alexander Ries as the responsible physician, it accepts statutory and private insurance and communicates in German, English and Russian. It also offers weight loss injections, travel medicine, diving and driver medical certificates and home visits for immobile patients. Extended hours, video consultations and separate phone lines for prescriptions and appointments make it highly accessible for the Frickenhausen community.
